summary: Largo Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release reporting Q2 2026 operating results. The release details vanadium pentoxide production of 2,900 tonnes (up 28.5% YoY), sales of 2,773 tonnes (up 53.4% YoY), and ilmenite concentrate sales of 10,059 tonnes (up 67.0% YoY). It also notes that vanadium oxides remain exempt from new U.S. Section 301 tariffs and highlights a U.S. Defense Logistics Agency delivery order. No transaction, strategic change, or special situation is disclosed; the filing is a routine operational update for a foreign private issuer.
